sentences.text:
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. R.J. Punia For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE FARJAND ALI Order 17/11/2023 The instant bail application has been filed by petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
against the order impugned passed by learned court below in connection with FIR No.87/2023 registered at Police Station Ramsar, District Barmer for the offences under Sections 363, 366A, 386 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and under Sections 3(a)/4 and 5(I)/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in judicial custody in connection with the above offences.
He further submits that a false case has been foisted against the petitioner and he has nothing to do with the alleged offences and no useful purpose would be served by keeping him behind the bars.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.
[2023:RJ-JD:39406] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-11031/2023] Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
None present for the complainant despite service.

After hearing the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, more particularly, the statement of the victim 'J' recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. on 27.07.2023, and also looking to the Pokar Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jd:39406) on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56710292/
1 possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, I deem it appropriate to accede the prayer made by the petitioner.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner Pokar Ram S/o Shankra Ram shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the Court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
